articles.title: Sennheiser Momentum 5 review: Great sound, incredible battery life, and few compromises | TechCrunch
articles.summary: I spent the last few weeks with the Sennheiser Momentum 5 to determine if this pair actually stands out, testing everything from sound quality and noise cancellation to comfort and battery life.
articles.body:
There are a lot of $300-$400 headphones on the market right now, and most of them blur together. I spent the last few weeks with the Sennheiser Momentum 5 to determine if this pair actually stands out, testing everything from sound quality and noise cancellation to comfort and battery life.

At $399.99, the Momentum 5 sit right in the middle of the premium headphone market. That puts them up against the pricier Sony WH-1000XM6 and Apple AirPods Max 2, while offering a more affordable option for anyone looking for high-end headphones.

Starting with sound, vocals sound natural and the bass is strong without taking over. The headphones allow you to start noticing little things in music, like a background harmony or a guitar string that cheaper headphones often tend to miss. If I had to describe the sound in one word, it’d be balanced.

The headphones support Dolby Atmos, which essentially means that music or movies sound like they’re coming from all around you instead of just left and right.

With this generation, Sennheiser doubled the microphone count to eight to improve the active noise cancellation (ANC). Voices and nearby chatter, which are usually the kind of sounds that can cut through weaker ANC, are noticeably quieter. Sennheiser claims this pair is up to three times more effective than the previous generation at blocking this type of noise.

Of course, it’s not quite at the level of blocking out everything like a plane’s engine, but it does the job effectively without making your ears feel weirdly pressurized as can be the case with some ANC headphones.

As for comfort, the headphones aren’t as premium-feeling as Apple or Sony headphones that I’ve tried in the past, but given that the Momentum 5 cost less than its competitors, it’s a trade-off that’s hard to complain about.

The battery life is genuinely impressive. It’s rated for up to 57 hours, and that figure held up in my testing. For context, that’s roughly twice the battery life of the Sony WH-1000XM6 and nearly three times that of the AirPods Max 2.

And when the battery does run out, a 10-minute charge gets you up to seven hours of playback, while a full charge takes about two hours.

A notable difference that the Momentum 5 offers that its competitors don’t is a user-replaceable cell, which means you can swap out the battery once it degrades instead of having to buy a whole new pair.

What I wasn’t expecting, but found surprisingly useful, was how thin the carrying case is. I’ve never really been able to fit a pair of headphones into my medium-sized purses, but the Momentum 5 fit perfectly. It’s also a big plus when traveling, since the case doesn’t take up much space in your luggage.

With the headphones’ companion app, Smart Control Plus, you can adjust a bunch of different settings. There’s an 8-band EQ that lets you tune the sound yourself or choose from one of Sennheiser’s presets. The app also lets you adjust the level of ANC rather than just switching it on or off, and there’s an anti-wind mode you can access there too. The “Sound Personalization” feature walks you through a listening test and creates a sound profile tailored to your hearing preferences.

The app gives you a decent amount of control over the Momentum 5, and I found it pretty easy to navigate as most of the settings are quite straightforward.

Overall, the Sennheiser Momentum 5 is a solid option at this price. They offer great sound, the battery life is excellent, and the downsides are pretty minor. They’re heavier than the Sony WH-1000XM6, and aren’t as comfortable as some Sony or Apple options, but at $399.99, they’re cheaper than both while still delivering where it matters.

articles.title: Kobo 6.0 beta is breaking some e-readers.
articles.summary:
If you haven’t opted into the company’s firmware betas, or just haven’t installed the latest, don’t. People are reporting endless loading screens, broken Libby integration, and missing data, including annotations and sideloaded books. Kobo is warning readers not to roll back the update, though, as it will make any missing data permanently unretrievable.

articles.title: Bigg Boss Telugu 10: No elimination this week as Mukesh sacrifices captaincy and immunity
articles.summary: The latest episode of Bigg Boss Telugu 10 came with a major twist as there was no elimination this week after captain Mukesh decided to give up his
articles.body: The latest episode of Bigg Boss Telugu 10 came with a major twist as there was no elimination this week after captain Mukesh decided to give up his captaincy and immunity to save Varshini and Vamsi. Both contestants were in the danger zone, and Nagarjuna gave Mukesh the final decision. He gave him a chance to cancel the elimination on the condition that he accept the consequences that came with the decision.At the end of the elimination process, Varshini and Vamsi were still in the danger zone. Nagarjuna then turned to Mukesh and said, “Captain Mukesh, this is your final temptation. The decision is yours. You can save the contestant who is about to be eliminated.” He added, “You will lose your captaincy. Along with that, you will also lose the immunity that came with it. You will be directly nominated. If you agree to all three conditions, the elimination will be cancelled.”The offer surprised Mukesh, who simply could not believe what he was hearing. Varshini and Vamsi both stood waiting for his response. He pondered the request before finally saying, “I feel that both of them are potential contestants, and I’m ready to give up my captaincy if both of them are saved.”Nagarjuna then announced that there would be no elimination this week as a result of Mukesh’s decision. This came as a relief to Varshini and Vamsi, who were moments away from seeing one of them leave the house.As far as Mukesh was concerned, his decision came at a steep price. According to the rules set by Bigg Boss, he would have to forfeit both his captaincy and immunity and be directly nominated. Nagarjuna later announced that Apoorva would take over as captain and receive the immunity power. She earned the opportunity because she and Mukesh had both emerged as winners in the captaincy task earlier in the week.Mukesh’s decision has already become one of the biggest talking points of the season. Although Varshini and Vamsi have both been saved, his gamble could very well come back to haunt him. After all, he has sacrificed his captaincy and is now facing direct nomination. It will be interesting to see what happens next week.Get the latest TV News, TV Shows and more. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: 'Want to score well': Friend says Sahil Wakode told her in 'last call' he was caught cheating
articles.summary: Mumbai crime branch records friend’s statement in IIT Bombay student Sahil Wakode suicide probe; she says he admitted cheating in a last call after exam.
articles.body: MUMBAI: The Mumbai crime branch probing the abetment to suicide of IIT-Bombay student Sahil Wakode has recorded the statement of a friend, who told investigators that she was the last person to speak to him on the phone.According to police, Wakode told her during the call that his thermodynamics theory paper had gone poorly and that he was worried as he had wanted to score well. He also told her that he had been caught cheating during the exam, they said.The friend, who is among at least six students whose statements have been recorded so far, told police that Wakode appeared stressed during their conversation. However, investigators have so far not found any clear indication of stress or distress in the material examined during the probe.Wakode (22), a second-year BTech student, was found dead in his hostel room hours after the exam on Sept 18.Investigators are reconstructing his movements after he left the exam hall. CCTV footage has established that Wakode left the hall after he was asked to do so and returned later.The CCTV footage has been sent for forensic analysis. Investigators are also examining Wakode’s locked iPhone, hoping to retrieve his last calls, messages and other data. Experts have so far been unable to access the phone because of its password.Police said they are currently recording the statements of students and other witnesses and will subsequently record the statement of Prof Suryanarayana Doolla, who was present during the exam.Wakode’s parents made an emotional appeal to IIT-B students to continue their protest and sought preservation of any evidence relating to the death. In another video message addressed to students, Wakode’s father said on Sunday he had been unable to enter the campus despite visiting it two or three times. articles.title: Bigg Boss Kannada 13 gets three new wild card contestants; Here’s everything about them
articles.summary: Bigg Boss Kannada 13 is getting more intense with every episode.
articles.body: Bigg Boss Kannada 13 is getting more intense with every episode. After a series of unexpected developments, including emergency exits and major twists inside the house, the reality show has now welcomed three new contestants as wild card entries.The latest wild card entrants are Ganavi Gowda, Sonika Gowda and Prashanth Gowda. Each of them comes with a different background in television, cinema, modelling and reality shows. Their entry is expected to bring a fresh dynamic to the ongoing competition.Ganavi Gowda joins Bigg Boss Kannada 13Ganavi Gowda is known for her stint on the reality show ‘Halli Power’. The first season of the show, where Ganavi emerged as the runner-up.With her previous experience in a reality show, Ganavi is now all set to take on a new challenge inside the Bigg Boss house. Her entry comes at a crucial stage of the competition, making her one of the contestants to watch in the upcoming episodes.Sonika Gowda enters as a wild card contestantSonika Gowda is an emerging actress, entrepreneur and model. She has appeared in several Kannada films, including Shataya Gataya, Naane Raja and Khushi Khushiyagi.Besides acting and modelling, Sonika is also an entrepreneur and runs her own Glamour House. With experience across different areas of the entertainment industry, she is now stepping into the Bigg Boss house as a wild card contestant.Gicchi GiliGili fame Prashanth Gowda enters the houseThe third wild card entrant is Prashanth Gowda, a familiar face among Kannada television and reality-show audiences.Prashanth was part of Gicchi GiliGili Seasons 1, 2 and 3 and has earned popularity on social media as ‘Talented Kalavida Prashanth.’ He has also participated in several reality shows, including Boys vs Girls and Quatle Kitchen, the latter of which he won.With three new faces joining the Bigg Boss Kannada 13 house, viewers can expect new equations, fresh rivalries and plenty of unexpected moments in the episodes ahead.
